_comment: Node 6a EMAIL TEXT-BACK: second failed email attempt / asks for a person / text me -> skip, email_capture_requested=true, SMS asks for email. Synthetic identity.

scenarios.name: TB-01 incident: first readback rejected + asks for somebody

history.content: Do you have an email address for the booking?
Naua: N-A-U-A-C-H-O-K-I-I@gmail.com.
So that's N, A, U, A, C, H, O, K, I, I, at gmail dot com. Is that right?
No. Can I speak to somebody, please?

dynamic_variables.phone_known: The caller's phone is already resolved; do not ask.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if, in this same turn, the agent (1) says it will book without the email and will text the caller shortly so they can reply with their email address, (2) calls smart_voice_agent intent="book" with email_capture_requested=true and NO patient_email, and (3) does NOT offer or mention a transfer, reception or a message for reception, and asks no further question (no mobile check, no 'is that right'). FAIL otherwise.
